lessons.claim: A sketch's connection topology must not be reconstructed automatically from eyeballed circle coordinates plus radii. Measured on intake/network's 21 beads: the centre distance/(r_i+r_j) is 0.73~1.34 (median 1.02) over the 20 real link pairs while the minimum over the 190 non-link pairs is 1.26, so **the distributions overlap and one distance cannot separate them**. The cause is that the radii were drawn smaller than the drawn ellipse semi-axes in order to fit the numbering on. Raising the threshold (TOL) to make it work would be fitting to the desired answer, so the links are **stated as read data** just like the coordinates and the distance diagnostic is output only as a quality indicator.
